changes: Extracted /body/core.js pure kernel and executable fixture selftest.
Made untouched state dimensions explicitly null; zero is recorded only when intentionally set.
Added SAME RETURN / NEXT RETURN ≤12H PULSE contrast lens with the same minimum-sample gate.
Recovered the unmerged BODY 0.1 lineage onto current master rather than merging the stale branch.
Replaced runtime-fetched body geometry with the shared same-repo /bodyplans/ registry.
Added NOW: one-gesture valence×activation capture, compact itch/pain/tension/energy/focus signals, context factors and optional detailed body address.
Added PULSE: seven-day cyclic time projection plus descriptive with-vs-without factor contrasts gated at n>=3 on each side.
Added TEST: one explicit action/intervention, selected target, baseline return, timed recheck and before/after receipt; no causal claim.
Added same-origin BODY↔HOUSE local bridge using private browser localStorage envelopes; no personal body state is committed to the repo.
Preserved body-plan geometry version/view/region identity and kept CARE as the episode/handoff instrument.
Added export/import/plain projection for durable local ownership.
Added explicit browser-local BODY → CARE handoff; CARE offers import into the current case rather than mutating automatically.
checks: body-plan registry is same-origin local asset
factor contrasts require >=3 with and >=3 without
BODY→CARE handoff is localStorage only and requires explicit CARE import
missing values excluded from numeric contrasts
lagged contrasts do not bridge gaps >12h
prior_art: How We Feel: low-friction emotion check-ins + body sensations/patterns
Bearable/Daylio: descriptive factor comparisons with sample coverage
RADAR-base/AWARE: active self-report distinct from passive context streams
honesty: This is a personal observation and experimentation instrument, not a diagnostic, triage, or treatment recommendation system. Same-origin HOUSE packets carry projection metadata/context, not private runtime authority.
